# CV-11 — Catch up, Later and Remind me

> Branch `t/maciej/cv-11-catchup-view` · status: built, waiting for its migration turn
> Migration: `supabase/migrations/20261016150000_chat_v2_later.sql` · applied to the local stack: no (waiting for its turn; dry-run green in a rolled-back transaction with every `chat_*` SQL test)

## Delivered against the row

- **Server** (`…_chat_v2_later.sql`):
  - `chat_op_remind(p_message_id, p_channel_id, p_at)`: one of a message or a conversation. On a message: your open items for it (a chain or an Every-message line names its newest message) are put off until `at` (`later_until`, `later_notified_at` reset) and their bell twins hidden; with nothing of yours open there, a `reminder` item (upsert on the per-message unique index, so a done reminder opens again). On a conversation (`/remind`): one open conversation reminder per person and conversation (new partial unique index), its message chosen when it comes due. `at = null` clears (a reminder is done; a put-off item shows again with its bell row). Refused: no person (a key, `42501 Sign in first.`), both or neither target, the past, beyond a year (`22023`), a message or conversation you can't read (`P0002`, worded like one that isn't there). No plan check (#25), no activity row (#15).
  - `chat__fire_later(p_now, p_limit)` every minute (`chat-fire-later`, `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`): due items come back (`later_notified_at`), the bell twin shows again, one `chat_reminder` notice through `notice__gate` (title "Reminder · Sender · #channel · Workspace", text only while "Show message text" is on, `tag = chat:<conversation>:remind:<item>`, `push_after` = now, link to the message). A conversation reminder takes the conversation's newest message then. Nothing is sent about what the person can no longer read.
  - Trigger `chat_catchup_snoozed_twin`: when the fan-out moves a put-off chain or line to a newer message (new bell row), that row is hidden too.
  - `chat_catchup_open(p_workspace_id)`: Catch up's list for the signed-in person: open items showing now, readable conversation (wherever the message is now), message not deleted, no team mention while "Your teams" is off, no Every-message line unless on Every message, no muted chain; quiet lines listed; `at` = newest message or when it came back.
  - Grants: the op to signed-in people (+ the service role, refused inside), the list to people only, the job and the trigger function server-only; asserted in the migration and in the test.
- **Client:**
  - `ChatRuntime` gains `messages(ids)`, `catchupOpen`, `catchupDone`, `catchupReopen`, `remind` (`runtime.chat.supabase.ts`; `chat_catchup_open` in `READ_RPCS`); `ChatCatchupItem` + `mapCatchupItem`.
  - `catchup/catchup-store.ts`: one list per chat store (`catchupStoreFor`), read only while watched; your Catch up rows moving (Realtime, `ChatStore.onCatchupChange`) re-read it after 400 ms; Done / Later hide at once and come back on a refusal; Undo; batches of 1,000. **`useCatchup(store)` is the widget's read (CV-22).**
  - `catchup/catchup-view.tsx` (`useCatchupScreen`): `/chat?view=catchup` (keeps `c`; Esc goes back to it). Centre per frame 1: "Catch up" + count + Display (By conversation / Newest first, kept per browser); groups (conversation name, count, ⋯ with "Done all in this conversation" and "Go to conversation"); rows: avatar, **who** + why ("mentioned you", "replied in a chain you're in", "direct message", "Acme · 12 new", "you asked to be reminded", quiet lines), one-line excerpt with people named, time. "Notifications are off in this browser" (CV-6b's `NOTICES_OFF_LINE`) above the list when the browser refused notices. Zero state: "You're caught up." + the §9 line (count of conversations with unread you weren't asked about).
  - Bottom bar mode row (`chat:catchup`): Reply R · Done Space · Task T · Later H · Open ⏎ · Go to conversation, More ▾ (Done all in this conversation), "N left · Esc". Keys on the page (↑↓ R Space T H ⏎ Esc), never inside a field, a dialog or a menu; Enter/Space on another button stay that button's.
  - Right side (frame 1): "In <conversation>" · Open conversation, the message in context (CV-8b's `MessageInContext`, ten either side), a reply box ("Reply to Sofia") that answers in the message's chain.
  - Later dialog (`catchup/later-dialog.tsx`, `later-times.ts`): In 1 hour · This evening (18:00, only before 18:00) · Tomorrow (9:00) · Pick a time… (date and time in the person's zone, ≤ 1 year), from Time & region's zone. Used by H in Catch up, the message ⋯ "Remind me…" (+ H on a selected message in the stream), and `/remind` in the composer.
  - The bell draws chat excerpts in the stored form (`payload.format_version = 2`): marks dropped, references named, a half reference cut by the server's excerpt dropped (`spine/activity.ts`, `markup-v2` `toExcerptText`).

## Agent's choices (deferred to by Maciej: confirmed for building, may be reconsidered)

- **Catch up's list is a server read (`chat_catchup_open`)** · agent · "only items you can still read" must hold for rows of conversations you left or lost; own-row RLS doesn't say that · rejected: client reads of `chat_catchup` + messages (would list items of conversations you can no longer read until a message read failed).
- **Nothing still lists** · agent · AC7.4 ("Nothing keeps @you in Catch up silently") wins over CV-5's note to hide what the count hides · rejected: hiding Nothing items.
- **A reminder rings even on a conversation set to Nothing, and isn't counted there** · agent · you asked for it; the count is `chat_unread_counts`' (CV-5's body, not redefined here) · revisit with CV-18.
- **"Back on top" = sorted by when it came back** (`at = greatest(message time, later_notified_at)`) · agent · rejected: a separate "Returned" section.
- **Later on a past time is refused** ("Pick a time in the future.") · agent · rejected: firing at the next minute.
- **"This evening" is offered only before 18:00** · agent · rejected: tomorrow evening in its place (a fourth meaning).
- **Clearing a reminder marks it Done; clearing Later shows the item again with its bell row** · agent.
- **A conversation reminder that finds you already keep a reminder on its newest message stays the conversation's (no message)** · agent · the per-message index allows one reminder row per message · it opens the conversation.
- **Six actions in the mode row: Reply · Done · Task · Later · Open · Go to conversation; More ▾ holds "Done all in this conversation"** · agent · frame 1 draws five then More; the bar's cap is six and the brief puts "Done all" behind ⋯/More · rejected: five and an empty sixth.
- **⏎ opens the right panel on the selected item** (selection already shows it there); "Open conversation" / "Go to conversation" land on the message · agent · the brief's test: "⏎ opens the message in context".
- **R focuses the reply box on the right, which answers in the message's chain** (`replyToId` = its root) · agent · like Reply in the stream (CV-12) · hidden where you can't post (archived, announcement channels, viewers, a paused plan, not a member).
- **Space and Done all show an Undo toast** · agent · the brief asks Undo for "Done all"; one grammar for both.
- **T opens the capture with the message's words** (the stream's `makeTaskFrom`) · the From chip is CV-10's capture source, not here.
- **Display order is kept per browser** (`localStorage`) · agent · rejected: a server pref (no such store for chat views yet).
- **Group header ⋯ also offers "Done all in this conversation"** · agent · frame 1's groups have no ⋯; reachable by mouse without the bottom bar.
- **The zero state's second line counts conversations you're in with unread and nothing addressed to you** · agent · "Three channels…" is the spec's example; one channel reads "One channel has… it'll keep."; none → only "Nothing is waiting for you."

## Gotchas (area: supabase)

- The local stack's scratchpad is shared between builders: name scratch scripts per block (another builder overwrote a `dry.sh`).
- `chat_unread_counts` compares `later_until` with `now()`: a test that fires the job with a future `p_now` sees the item back in the list but not in the count; move `later_until` back instead (`test.elapse`).

## For later blocks

- **CV-22:** `useCatchup(store)` (`catchup/catchup-store.ts`) is the widget's read: `snapshot.items` (+ `messages`), read while mounted.
- **CV-18:** `chat__fire_later` already calls `notice__gate(…, 'chat_reminder', …)`; give the gate its rules. A reminder on a Nothing conversation isn't counted (`chat_unread_counts`); decide with the count's re-cut.
- **CV-15:** `added` / `removed` quiet lines already render ("Mike added you to Launch").
- **CV-23:** `chat_catchup_open` repeats `chat_unread_counts`' Catch up rules (minus Nothing and quiet lines); keep them together when either changes.
- **CV-12 / later:** a chain item in Catch up opens as the message in context, not as CV-12's chain item, so it doesn't call `chat_op_chain_read`: replies a wrap-up hid stay in Catch up until Done or the chain is read elsewhere.
- **Search (CV-9/CV-19):** `MessageInContext` in Catch up's right side is wrapped by `CatchupContext` (title "In <conversation>").

## Manual checklist (step → expect → surface)

- [ ] Someone @mentions you twice, replies twice in your chain, DMs you → Catch up (left panel) lists three groups; the chain is one row on its newest reply; the bottom bar shows the mode row and "N left · Esc" → web
- [ ] ↑↓ move; ⏎ opens the right panel with the message in context; R puts the caret in "Reply to …"; sending replies in the chain and the row leaves → web
- [ ] Space clears with Undo; H → In 1 hour → gone; it comes back on top after an hour with one notice → web + desktop notice
- [ ] More ▾ → Done all in this conversation → the group leaves; Undo brings it back → web
- [ ] A message's ⋯ → Remind me… → Tomorrow → it's in Catch up at 9:00 your time, once → web
- [ ] `/remind` in the composer → pick a time → the conversation's newest message returns then → web
- [ ] Display → Newest first: one list with the conversation's name on each row → web
- [ ] Browser notices refused → "Notifications are off in this browser" above the list → web
- [ ] Everything done → "You're caught up." and the quiet-channels line → web

## Verify before release

- The cron job `chat-fire-later` exists on prod after the migration (`select * from cron.job where jobname = 'chat-fire-later'`).
- Verify a reminder rings on desktop and in the browser (CV-6b's ring path must take `chat_reminder` rows; `deliveries.ts` already names the kind).
